# Quilt Lightbox Site

> Static website for the Quilt Lightbox app: its privacy policy and contact page. Plain HTML and CSS, served by GitHub Pages from the main branch.

## Pages

- [Home](https://caputodavide93.github.io/quilt-lightbox-site/): what the app is
- [Privacy policy](https://caputodavide93.github.io/quilt-lightbox-site/privacy/): the app collects no data; everything stays on the device
- [Contact](https://caputodavide93.github.io/quilt-lightbox-site/contact/): email and common questions

## Key facts

- No scripts, forms, cookies, analytics or web fonts.
- Preview locally: `python3 -m http.server 8000`.
- Contact: caputodav@gmail.com
